audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for cheerful giving, sufficiency, sowing/reaping, thanksgiving, service, overflowing grace.

verses.restored: For concerning the service to the holy ones, it is superfluous for me to write to you.

familiar.text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

modern.text: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.

original.text: Περὶ μὲν γὰρ τῆς διακονίας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους περισσόν μοί ἐστιν τὸ γράφειν ὑμῖν,

verses.restored: For I know your eagerness, of which I boast about you to Macedonians, that Achaia has been prepared since last year; and your zeal stirred up the majority.

familiar.text: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

modern.text: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.

original.text: οἶδα γὰρ τὴν προθυμίαν ὑμῶν ἣν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καυχῶμαι Μακεδόσιν ὅτι Ἀχαΐα παρεσκεύασται ἀπὸ πέρυσι, καὶ ⸀τὸ ὑμῶν ζῆλος ἠρέθισε τοὺς πλείονας.

verses.restored: But I sent the siblings so that our boasting about you may not be emptied in this respect, so that just as I was saying, you may be prepared,

familiar.text: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

modern.text: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.

original.text: ἔπεμψα δὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς, ἵνα μὴ τὸ καύχημα ἡμῶν τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν κενωθῇ ἐν τῷ μέρει τούτῳ, ἵνα καθὼς ἔλεγον παρεσκευασμένοι ἦτε,

verses.restored: lest if Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we, not to say you, should be put to shame in this confidence.

familiar.text: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

modern.text: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.

original.text: μή πως ἐὰν ἔλθωσιν σὺν ἐμοὶ Μακεδόνες καὶ εὕρωσιν ὑμᾶς ἀπαρασκευάστους καταισχυνθῶμεν ἡμεῖς, ἵνα μὴ ⸀λέγωμεν ὑμεῖς, ἐν τῇ ὑποστάσει ⸀ταύτῃ.

verses.restored: Therefore I considered it necessary to appeal to the siblings, that they go ahead to you and prepare beforehand your previously promised blessing, so that this may be ready as blessing and not as greed/compulsion.

familiar.text: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

modern.text: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.

original.text: ἀναγκαῖον οὖν ἡγησάμην παρακαλέσαι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἵνα προέλθωσιν ⸀εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ προκαταρτίσωσι τὴν ⸀προεπηγγελμένην εὐλογίαν ὑμῶν, ταύτην ἑτοίμην εἶναι οὕτως ὡς εὐλογίαν καὶ μὴ ὡς πλεονεξίαν.

verses.restored: This then: the one sowing sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one sowing upon blessings will also reap upon blessings.

familiar.text: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

modern.text: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

original.text: Τοῦτο δέ, ὁ σπείρων φειδομένως φειδομένως καὶ θερίσει, καὶ ὁ σπείρων ἐπʼ εὐλογίαις ἐπʼ εὐλογίαις καὶ θερίσει.

verses.restored: Each as one has chosen beforehand in the heart, not from grief or necessity; for the Divine loves a cheerful giver.

familiar.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

modern.text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.

original.text: ἕκαστος καθὼς ⸀προῄρηται τῇ καρδίᾳ, μὴ ἐκ λύπης ἢ ἐξ ἀνάγκης· ἱλαρὸν γὰρ δότην ἀγαπᾷ ὁ θεός.

verses.restored: And the Divine is powerful to make all grace abound into you, so that in all things, always having all sufficiency, you may abound into every good work,

familiar.text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

modern.text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

original.text: ⸀δυνατεῖ δὲ ὁ θεὸς πᾶσαν χάριν περισσεῦσαι εἰς ὑμᾶς, ἵνα ἐν παντὶ πάντοτε πᾶσαν αὐτάρκειαν ἔχοντες περισσεύητε εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθόν·

verses.restored: just as it is written: He scattered, he gave to the poor; his righteousness/justice remains into the age.

familiar.text: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

modern.text: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”

original.text: (καθὼς γέγραπται· Ἐσκόρπισεν, ἔδωκεν τοῖς πένησιν, ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·

verses.restored: The One supplying seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed and increase the fruits of your righteousness/justice.

familiar.text: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

modern.text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.

original.text: ὁ δὲ ἐπιχορηγῶν ⸀σπόρον τῷ σπείροντι καὶ ἄρτον εἰς βρῶσιν ⸀χορηγήσει καὶ ⸀πληθυνεῖ τὸν σπόρον ὑμῶν καὶ ⸀αὐξήσει τὰ γενήματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης ὑμῶν·)

verses.restored: In everything being enriched into all generosity, which through us works thanksgiving to the Divine.

familiar.text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

modern.text: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to God.

original.text: ἐν παντὶ πλουτιζόμενοι εἰς πᾶσαν ἁπλότητα, ἥτις κατεργάζεται διʼ ἡμῶν εὐχαριστίαν τῷ θεῷ—

verses.restored: For the service of this liturgy is not only filling up the lacks of the holy ones, but also overflowing through many thanksgivings to the Divine.

familiar.text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

modern.text: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.

original.text: ὅτι ἡ διακονία τῆς λειτουργίας ταύτης οὐ μόνον ἐστὶν προσαναπληροῦσα τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν ἁγίων, ἀλλὰ καὶ περισσεύουσα διὰ πολλῶν εὐχαριστιῶν τῷ θεῷ—

verses.restored: Through the testedness of this service, they glorify the Divine for the submission of your confession into the good news of Messiah and for the generosity of the fellowship/participation toward them and toward all,

familiar.text: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

modern.text: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.

original.text: διὰ τῆς δοκιμῆς τῆς διακονίας ταύτης δοξάζοντες τὸν θεὸν ἐπὶ τῇ ὑποταγῇ τῆς ὁμολογίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἁπλότητι τῆς κοινωνίας εἰς αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰς πάντας,

verses.restored: and in their prayer for you, longing for you because of the surpassing grace of the Divine upon you.

familiar.text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

modern.text: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

original.text: καὶ αὐτῶν δεήσει ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐπιποθούντων ὑμᾶς διὰ τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐφʼ ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: Thanks to the Divine for his indescribable gift.

familiar.text: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

modern.text: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!

original.text: ⸀χάρις τῷ θεῷ ἐπὶ τῇ ἀνεκδιηγήτῳ αὐτοῦ δωρεᾷ.

translation_notes: Giving remains grace, blessing, and chosen-hearted generosity, not compulsion.
Sufficiency is communal: abundance is for every good work and for filling the lacks of the holy ones.
